transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. As you know, I'm putting together a keepsake archive for Grandma's ninetieth birthday — we've got about 300 old 35mm negatives from decades of family gatherings and vacations, and I want to create something really special. The archive could include a printed album, digital copies for all the relatives, and preserved original negatives. We need everything ready before the birthday celebration in October, so we have some time but not a lot of it to spare. Before I lock in any plan, I want to do what I always do for family projects — go around and give each person a chance to raise any practical or personal concerns. So let's hear from everyone, and then I'll make the final calls. Who wants to start?
